channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dell Demps | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dell Demps from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Dell Demps
item.description:
Will Guillory:Magic Johnson on First Take:

“I told Dell Demps, 'Let's (negotiate) in private. What we offer, let's keep it between us.' Dell didn't do that. So, that's how it go out.”

Magic Johnson on Dell Demps, May 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Dell Demps
item.description:
DeMarcus Cousins on not receiving an offer from the Pelicans:

“Only me and Dell Demps know what was said on the phone that night. We both know the truth. I’ll leave it at that.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Dell Demps, Jul 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Mickey Loomis on Dell Demps, Alvin Gentry
item.description:
The following is a statement from New Orleans Pelicans Owner Tom Benson and Executive Vice President of Basketball Operations Mickey Loomis:

“After careful and thorough review of basketball operations,we have made the determination that the best course of action as we move forward into the 2017-18 season is to continue under the leadership of General Manager Dell Demps and Head Coach Alvin Gentry.”

Mickey Loomis on Dell Demps, Alvin Gentry, May 15, 2017. Source: NBA.com.
